title: Checkout
days: {days, plural, one {# rental day} other {# rental days}}

noDates.title: Pick your dates first
noDates.text: Without dates we can’t calculate the price or find a free bike.

handover.title: Pick-up
handover.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to mark the spot.

contact.title: Contact
contact.hint: The manager will call or message you if anything changes.
contact.invalid: Check the number: use the format +84 912 345 678
contact.required: Enter a phone number so we can reach you
contact.sentNoPhone: Contact sent to the bot. Enter the number here too so it’s attached to the booking.

docs.title: Documents and licence
docs.warning: Vietnam requires a category A1 licence (bikes up to 125 cc) or category A (from 150 cc). An International Driving Permit (IDP) is accepted only under the 1968 Vienna Convention; an IDP under the 1949 Geneva Convention is not accepted. The 2026 fine for riding without a valid licence is 2–4 million ₫. The manager checks the originals at pick-up.
docs.lead: Your passport and licence photos come first: you can't book without them.

method.title: Payment method
method.vietqrNote: Pay by QR in your banking app. The status updates by itself.
method.cashNote: The booking is confirmed right away; you pay the manager at pick-up.
method.cashPrepayNote: Pay {percent}% now, the rest to the manager at pickup.
method.rubNote: Pay the rent in rubles by phone number from your bank's app. The deposit is paid in cash at pick-up. We confirm the booking as soon as we see the money.

breakdown.title: Total
breakdown.rent: Rental, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
breakdown.depositNote: The deposit isn’t part of the price and is returned when the bike comes back undamaged.
breakdown.depositCashNote: The deposit is paid to the manager in cash at pick-up and returned the same way when the bike comes back undamaged.

blocked.license: Without a licence only bikes up to 50 cc are available
blocked.documents: Upload photos of your documents: you can't book without them. Show me
blocked.consent: Tick the agreement to the rules to continue

taken.text: The bike was taken while you were checking out. Pick another bike for these dates or change the dates.
